results.title: MIT Athletics | MIT Admissions
results.snippet: We have an “activities period” from 5pm to 7pm each night, when no class activities can be held, and many varsity sports practice then. MIT competes in Division III, which means, among other things, that you’re not going to get an athletic scholarship to MIT, and that you’re probably not going to get into MIT with a 0 on the SAT, even if you can throw a football/baseball/basketball/other projectile.
